data.name: Jabbarnisa
data.gender_notes: Jabbarnisa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jabbarnisa is a beautiful and strong name meaning 'Gem of the sea' in Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic words 'Jabbar' (great, powerful) and 'Nisa' (woman), conveying the idea of a woman of immense strength and beauty, like a precious gem found in the depths of the sea. The name Jabbarnisa carries the meaning “Gem of the sea” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Jabbarnisa usually hope their child will grow to embody gem of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and resilience of a woman, drawing inspiration from the vast and powerful ocean.
data.etymology: Jabbarnisa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gem of the sea.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabbarnisa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
